brief.disclaimer: Entirely fictional. 'Lumen' and 'Nova 2' are invented for this demo and do not describe any real company or product.
brief.summary: Nova 2 is a new multimodal model powering the Lumen assistant app. Launch includes a press announcement, an early access creator program, assistant app rollout in 14 regions, and a browser integration.
facts: Press announcement and blog post go live when the embargo lifts at 09:00 PT on launch day.
Early access creator program is planned to open 2027-02-01 with ~200 creators under NDA.
Red team sign-off is currently scheduled for 2027-02-08.
Legal review of all performance and safety claims takes 10 business days from submission.
Marketing copy lock is 5 calendar days before launch.
Regional teams publish at 09:00 local time on launch day across 14 regions, including Japan (JST, UTC+9) and Australia (AEDT, UTC+11).
The browser integration is expected to ship 2027-03-17, one week after launch.
The press release draft says the assistant is 'available in the browser today'.
Localized safety disclaimers need Legal-approved wording before translation starts. No Regional owner is assigned for this yet.

tasks.title: Draft press release and launch blog
Submit performance and safety claims to Legal
Creator comms kit for early access

asks.request: Turn around claims review in time for copy lock
Confirm every surface named in the press release is live at launch

tasks.title: Complete red team and safety sign-off
Assistant app rollout config for 14 regions
Review performance and safety claims (10 business days)

risks.title: Asia-Pacific publishes before the embargo lifts
risks.evidence: Embargo lifts 2027-03-10 09:00 PT (17:00 UTC). Regional publishes at 09:00 local: Tokyo is 00:00 UTC on 03-10 and Sydney is 22:00 UTC on 03-09, so they go live 17 and 19 hours early (REG-5 vs PR-6).
risks.mitigation: Hold APAC publish until 2027-03-11 02:00 JST / 04:00 AEDT, or move the embargo earlier for all regions. Decide by 2027-02-20.

risks.title: Legal review finishes after copy lock
risks.evidence: PR-2 submits claims 2027-02-22. Ten business days puts LEG-2 at 2027-03-08, three days after copy lock (PR-5, 03-05). REG-1 translation waits on locked copy.
risks.mitigation: Move PR-2 submission to 2027-02-15 (the Planner date) so approval lands 03-01; pre-clear the top 5 claims in a fast-track review.

risks.title: Press release claims browser availability on launch day
risks.evidence: Draft says 'available in the browser today' but PRD-4 ships 2027-03-17, one week after launch.
risks.mitigation: Change copy to 'coming to the browser next week', or pull PRD-4 into the launch date if Product confirms feasibility.

risks.title: Creators get access before red team sign-off
risks.evidence: PRD-1 opens early access 2027-02-01; PRD-2 red team sign-off is 2027-02-08. Creators would use an unsigned-off model for a week.
risks.mitigation: Open early access 2027-02-09, or give creators a red-teamed checkpoint only.

risks.title: No owner for localized safety disclaimers
risks.evidence: REG-3 owner is TBD. It depends on LEG-3 (02-19) and must finish by 03-08 for 14 regions.
risks.mitigation: Assign a Regional PMM owner this week and pair with Policy Counsel.

risks.title: Two days for translation across 14 regions
risks.evidence: REG-1 starts 03-05 and REG-2 is due 03-08. Tight but feasible if R2 is fixed and source copy is final.
risks.mitigation: Pre-translate non-claim copy from the 03-01 draft.

synthesizer.headline: Nova 2 is on track for 2027-03-10 only if three cross-team conflicts are resolved by 2027-02-20.

workstreams.summary: Claims submission is too late for copy lock, and the release overstates browser availability.
Early access opens a week before red team sign-off; browser ships a week after launch.
APAC would publish before the embargo; disclaimer localization has no owner.
Review capacity is fine if claims arrive by 02-15.

decisions_needed: Choose: hold APAC publish to the PT embargo, or move the global embargo earlier (by 02-20).
Approve moving the Legal claims submission to 02-15.
Choose browser messaging: 'coming next week' or pull the browser ship date forward.
Confirm early access opens after red team sign-off.
